newsitem.title: POLAND: GTE, Telia buy Polish U S West unit.
newsitem.headline: GTE, Telia buy Polish U S West unit.

text.p: U.S. company GTE Corp on Friday said its GTE Directories unit and Swedish telecom operator Telia bought US West Polska, part of U S West Communications Inc for an undisclosed sum.
"US West Polska, the largest phone directory publisher in Poland, was sold by US West International to the GTE and Telia," GTE said.
GTE will own 51 percent of US West Polska taking operational control over the company, Telia will take the remaining 49-percent stake.
The transaction has yet to be approved by Poland's Market Competition and Consumer Protection Office, the statement said.

U S West International, which is part of the U.S. regional Bell U S West Communications, now intends to concentrate on cable and cellular telephone systems, its president Gary Ames said in the statement.
The firm already earmarked 90 percent of its investments for the purpose, he added.
